Getting started with DevTools Forge

DevTools Forge is a free suite of browser-based developer tools. This guide shows how to use them: every tool runs in your browser, needs no account, and never uploads your files, so you can follow along with your own documents safely. Start with the PDF merge tool or return to the tool index.

Merge a set of PDFs

Open the PDF merge tool, drag two or more PDF files onto the page, and arrange them in the order you want. Choose Merge and the combined file downloads back to your computer. The merge runs locally, so the files are never sent anywhere.

Format and validate JSON

Paste JSON into the formatter and it pretty-prints the document with two-space indentation. If the JSON is invalid, the formatter reports the line and column of the first error and the token it did not expect, so you can find the problem quickly.

Work offline

Every tool keeps working with no network connection once its page has loaded, because the processing happens in your browser rather than on a server. You can bookmark a tool and use it on a plane or an air-gapped machine. Our privacy note explains why nothing you open is ever uploaded.

Keyboard shortcuts

Press the forward-slash key to focus the main input on any tool, and press Escape to clear it. These shortcuts are listed again at the bottom of each tool page for reference.
